title: Data Analyst
description:
**About SuperLabs**

SuperLabs is an engineering \& IT consulting firm. To know more about SuperLabs \& the work we do, visit https://superlabs.co/

**About the Role**

We are looking for 0 \-1 experience range **Data Analyst** who can handle data\-related requirements end to end — from identifying and collecting data from various sources to data analysis, reporting, and generating actionable business insights.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience with **SQL, relational databases, data cleaning, data transformation, reporting, and BI tools**, along with the ability to independently manage the complete data lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify, understand, and work with data from multiple sources such as relational databases, APIs, application/product databases, spreadsheets, CSV files, third\-party platforms, and other business systems.
* Extract, clean, transform, validate, and consolidate data from different sources.
* Work extensively with relational databases and write efficient SQL queries.
* Understand data structures, relationships, schemas, and data flows across different systems.
* Perform data quality checks, reconciliation, and identify inconsistencies or gaps in source data.
* Build and maintain reports, dashboards, KPIs, and analytical models.
* Analyze business, customer, product, operational, and transactional data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.
* Work with stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into data\-driven solutions.
* Perform ad\-hoc analysis and root\-cause analysis for business and data\-related issues.
* Automate repetitive reporting and data\-processing tasks wherever possible.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, business, and operations teams on data requirements.
* Maintain documentation around data sources, datasets, metrics, queries, and reporting processes.

**Required Skills**

* Strong SQL skills with hands\-on experience working with relational databases such as **MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server**, or similar.
* Good understanding of **data sources, data integration, data modelling, ETL/ELT, and data pipelines**.
* Strong knowledge of data cleaning, transformation, validation, and analysis.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets**.
* Experience with BI tools such as **Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Metabase**, or similar.
* Understanding of basic statistics and analytical techniques.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage the complete data lifecycle, from **source identification to actionable insights**.

**Good to Have**

* Knowledge of **Python for data analysis**, including Pandas, NumPy, etc.
* Experience working with **APIs and JSON data**.
* Experience with cloud data warehouses such as **BigQuery, Snowflake, or Amazon Redshift**.
* Exposure to **product, customer, marketing, or business analytics**.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong ownership and ability to work independently.
* A structured and analytical approach to solving data\-related problems.
* Ability to work with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to data accuracy and quality.
* Ability to convert raw data into meaningful insights that support business decisions.

title: Data Analytics Intermediate Analyst
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Data Analytics Intmd Analyst is a Governance and developing professional role. The incumbent deals with most problems independently and has some latitude to solve complex problems. This role integrates in\-depth specialty area knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices, and demonstrates a good understanding of how the team and area integrate with others in accomplishing the objectives of the subfunction/job family.


The role applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools and methodologies, requiring attention to detail when making judgments and recommendations based on the analysis of factual information. In addition to core analytics duties, this role also incorporates elements of **data governance and data risk \& control awareness**, requiring the ability to handle ambiguity and complexity, and to partner across teams on governance\-related initiatives. The individual typically deals with variable issues with potentially broader business impact, applies professional judgment when interpreting data and results, and breaks down information in a systematic and communicable manner.


Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information and to guide and influence stakeholders on governance\-related matters. This role has a moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities; the quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of the analyst's own team as well as other closely related teams.


Responsibilities


Core Data Analytics Responsibilities


* Integrates in\-depth data analysis knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices.
* Demonstrates a good understanding of how data analytics teams and area integrate with others in accomplishing objectives.
* Applies project management skills.
* Applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools and methodologies.
* Analyzes factual information to make accurate judgments and recommendations focused on local operations and broader impacts.
* Applies professional judgment when interpreting data and results, breaking down information in a systematic and communicable manner.
* Employs developed communication and diplomacy skills to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information.
* Demonstrates attention to quality and timeliness of service to ensure the effectiveness of the team and group.
* Provides informal guidance or on\-the\-job training to new team members.
* Appropriately assesses risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct, and business practices, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.
* Partners with multiple teams to support the implementation of relevant Data Governance policies and/or the Data Risk and Control framework as applicable to the analytics function.
* Provides input and support on Data Governance and/or Data Risk and Controls framework matters, including performance monitoring and self\-assessment processes related to data used in analysis.
* Supports oversight and analysis of data\-related issues, including tracking of ownership, target dates, and associated metrics and reporting.
* Gathers and synthesizes metrics on existing Data Governance and/or Data Risk and Controls principles, policies, practices, and standards, including awareness of industry best practices, to inform data analytics work
* Assists in establishing and maintaining the Industry **Governance Policy** execution framework, including data cataloging, data lineage, and data quality capabilities
* Evaluates business processes to align with regulatory requirements and internal governance standards

Qualifications


Core Qualifications


* 4\-8 years of relevant experience
* Knowledge of tools for statistical modeling of large data sets.
* Ability to effectively use complex analytical, interpretive, and problem\-solving techniques.
* Demonstrated interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Working knowledge of Data Governance and/or Data Risk and Control principles, policies, and frameworks (e.g., data policy adoption, data quality, and issue management processes) is a plus.
* Ability to handle ambiguity and complexity, and to adapt quickly to changing requirements.
* Good analytical skills to filter, prioritize, and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources
* Hands\-on experience with GitHub — including repository management, branching, pull requests, and version control best practices
* Familiarity with Lightspeed (LSE/LSC) or equivalent enterprise CI/CD platforms — understanding of build pipelines, deployment workflows, and DevOps\-integrated environments
* Experience with data cataloging, data lineage, or metadata management tools is a plus
* Applies digital skills, including the use of **AI\-assisted tools**, to enhance BAU (Business\-as\-Usual) activities and improve governance efficiency

title: BI Analyst
description:
OneMagnify is an AI native, platform\-enabled B2B digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity. We help complex organizations drive measurable business outcomes by building smarter customer experiences and delivering highly integrated solutions across digital, media, and technology. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced analytics and artificial intelligence, we enable our clients to make better decisions, move faster, and compete more effectively in dynamic markets.

**The Impact You’ll Have:**


We are hiring a BI Analyst to own the design, build and support of Power BI reporting for business teams across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Credit, Mobility, Connected Vehicle and Warranty. The majority of the work is hands\-on Power BI development on top of data in Google Cloud (BigQuery). You will work directly with business users to understand what they need, model the data properly, and deliver dashboards people actually use.

**What you’ll do:**

* Build and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports and datasets end to end — requirement gathering, data model, DAX measures, visuals, publishing and support.
* Write and tune SQL in BigQuery to prepare clean, reliable datasets for reporting.
* Design star\-schema data models and reusable, certified datasets so business teams can self\-serve instead of asking for one\-off reports.
* Set up refresh schedules, gateways, workspaces, row\-level security and deployment pipelines; keep report performance and query cost under control.
* Build transformation pipelines in Dataform (or dbt\-style SQL models) and schedule them; use Cloud Run / Cloud Functions for lightweight automation where needed.
* Investigate data issues, trace them back to the source, and put basic data quality checks in place.
* Sit with business stakeholders, translate their questions into metric definitions and specs, and document what you build.
* Replace manual and Excel\-based reporting with automated solutions.
* Support Gen AI / Vertex AI use cases where useful — natural\-language Q\&A on datasets, automated summaries, Copilot features in Power BI.
* Review work from junior analysts and help them level up.

**What you’ll need:**

* 3–7 years of hands\-on BI / reporting experience, with the bulk of it in Power BI (Power Query, DAX, data modelling, Power BI Service administration)/ similar tools.
* Strong SQL — joins, aggregations, window functions, and the ability to debug a slow query.
* Practical experience with a cloud data warehouse. GCP BigQuery preferred; Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse / Fabric or Redshift equally considered.
* Working knowledge of ETL/ELT concepts and at least one transformation or workflow tool — Dataform, dbt, Alteryx, SAS, Dataflow or similar.
* Understanding of dimensional modelling and how to structure data for reporting rather than just extracting it.
* Ability to talk to non\-technical stakeholders, push back sensibly, and explain numbers clearly.
* A degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Statistics, Business Analytics or any quantitative field.

**Future\-Ready Skills (Nice to Have):**

* Python (pandas) for data prep or automation.
* Vertex AI, Gen AI / LLM\-assisted analytics, or Power BI Copilot exposure.
* Tableau, Qlik Sense or Looker experience alongside Power BI.
* Git / DevOps, CI\-CD for BI artefacts, Agile ways of working.
* Power Automate / Power Apps for workflow automation.
* Microsoft PL\-300 or Google Professional Data Engineer certification.
* Experience in integrated marketing, digital agency, marketing services, or consulting environments preferred.

**Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive benefits package including Medical Insurance, PF, Gratuity, paid holidays, and more.

**We are an equal opportunity employer**


We believe that Innovative ideas and solutions start with unique perspectives. That’s why we’re committed to providing every employee a workplace that’s free of discrimination and intolerance. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively search for like\-minded people to join our team.

title: Lead Business Analyst - Financial Services
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking a **Lead Business Analyst** to drive business analysis and product ownership activities for Financial Services, with a Wealth Management lens. You will work closely with the proxy product owner to define capabilities, write epics and stories, and ensure feedback flows into an actionable, prioritized backlog.

**Responsibilities**

* Align with the onsite proxy product owner on product vision and product roadmap
* Identify and define product capabilities, features, and functions
* Define epics and stories and document success criteria
* Refine stories by clarifying business logic and business results
* Own product scope and prioritize capabilities, epics, and stories
* Attend sprint review demos and provide timely feedback
* Log feedback and ensure it is incorporated and prioritized in the backlog
* Contribute to incident triaging
* Provide answers to business questions and clarifications as the key contact

**Requirements**

* Significant experience (10\-15 years overall), including 8\+ years delivering business analysis and requirements management
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a comparable field; master's degree in computer science is a plus
* Relevant product management background
* Proven experience in financial services, preferably focused on wealth management
* Strong business acumen with the ability to provide business and end client perspective
* Strong communication and presentation skills

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)
